title: Principal Product Manager
description:
Job Overview

Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG) is the world leader in online travel and related services, provided to customers and partners in over 220 countries and territories through six primary consumer-facing brands - Booking.com, KAYAK, Priceline, Agoda.com, Rentalcars.com, and OpenTable. The mission of Booking Holdings is to make it easier for everyone to experience the world. During 2019, the Company had consolidated revenues and net income of $15.1 billion and $4.9 billion, respectively, and a current market value of approximately $90 billion.

Booking Holdings Bangalore is a Center of Excellence based in Bangalore, India and a legal entity of Booking Holdings Inc. The Center was created to support the increasing business demands of the Booking Holdings Brands. The Center of Excellence provides access to specialized and highly skilled talent, leading industry best practices, and collaboration opportunities across all of the Booking Holdings brands and business units.

A Principal Product Manager is tasked with dealing with problems that rely on significant collaboration and alignment across not only tracks within departments, but often business units or businesses (e.g. between BKNG brands). A Principal Product Manager will often lead multiple teams, but will also be a single POC or lead a strategically important cross-departmental initiative. They own some of the most complex or ambiguous problems for the business, where risks and stakes are also often highest. A Principal Product Manager owns products/domains that drive the business forward in strategically important or novel ways. In an optimization-setting, impact will mean achieving meaningful business outcomes through their product or portfolio where their personal impact on their product’s success is evident. In an NPD setting this might mean creating a successful product strategy that leads to relevant and meaningful business outcomes or investments. PPMs are expected to be craft leaders and highly engaged in the product community, giving talks, mentoring and helping to shape our recruitment processes. PPMs are strong communicators, particularly of their specialist domains.A Principal Product Manager is not expected to be people managers. They are the pinnacle of individual contributor PM roles at Booking.com

Key Job Responsibilities and Duties

  • Lead product management for one of the Fintech Products track within the Booking.com FinTech organization:

    • Work effectively with a diverse, inclusive and high-performing team of product managers;

    • Be the cross-functional leader, and foster effective collaboration across teams and departments.

  • Product Strategy:

    • Translate business strategy into a Track strategy or a large program strategy, maintaining the right level of guidance and autonomy for teams to define specifics.

    • Own and define objectives at Track-level or Large program level.

    • Generate broad alignment on strategy within Department leadership and beyond, being spokesperson and leader for the Track.

  • Product Delivery:

    • Own the long-term roadmap for the Track or a large program.

    • Identify risks and dependencies early-on, and plan for mitigations.

    • Resolve dependencies and blockers across Track roadmaps and optimize deliverables across different teams/tracks/areas.

    • Define and run the processes that teams within the Track or Program need to execute efficiently.

    • Uses insights gathered from data to drive roadmap planning and quarterly goal setting for multiple products.

  • Drive a Customer Centric Mindset across the track or Program:

    • Is familiar with research practices and principles and can use them in partnership with researchers to distill feedback into actionable hypotheses.

    • Analyses and distills customer feedback from a variety of sources into actionable hypotheses, uncover unmet needs, validates or invalidates new concepts or improves existing products.

  • Stakeholder Management:

    • Identifies other teams and key stakeholders impacted by the current project.

    • Proactively builds relationships and learns about the needs and plans of other areas across the business and understands how they might interact with their own area.

    • Represents the overarching work of the track or program in a compelling and engaging way.

    • Manages stakeholder expectations with timely, concise and clear progress updates, adapted to stakeholder needs and via different mediums (verbal, written, presentation).

    • Manages expectations up to VP level (occasionally LT).

    • Coaches and mentors team to improve their stakeholder management.

  • Tech Fluency:

    • Partners with SEM and other senior tech leaders, actively learns the technical side of their work.

    • Understands what the most critical elements of the technical solution are and can explain and justify the chosen technical solutions.

    • Understands how the multiple systems used to deliver the product are interrelated and anticipates more complex problems or edge cases.

    • Ensures a high-quality user experience with our products by showing technical awareness and understanding of risks.

    • Ensures the technical feature development and strategy are scoped to satisfy the short and long term needs of the business.

    • Proactively reduces duplication in technical investments across the business.

    • Ensures track holds high standards of product quality, stability and maintainability.

    • Builds bridges between technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Community Impact:

    • Frequent interviewer for (S,G)PM roles outside of their Track.

    • Encouraged to be a content creator and manager of learning content dedicated to their area of expertise.

    • Lead working groups in the Community focused on craft projects.

    • Encouraged to occasionally speak at external craft community events outside of Booking.com.

    • Available for mentoring/coaching of more junior PMs outside of their own track.

Qualifications

  • Technology Platform Acumen (5+ Years):

    • Proven experience setting the product vision and strategy at the intersection of complex, large-scale technical domains, specifically in payments, master data management (MDM), and financial data products.

    • A demonstrated "product-first" mindset with a track record of evolving complex systems into scalable, reliable platforms through deep discovery and clear strategic roadmaps.

  • Exceptional skills in deep stakeholder discovery, translating complex business needs into a clear modernization strategy, and making tough prioritization/sequencing decisions to optimize business value.

  • Hands-on experience defining strategies for partner/customer master data that connect and unify an entire business lifecycle (e.g., contracting, onboarding, payout operations, and finance).

  • Expertise in holistically defining transactional and analytical data products, with a relentless focus on data quality, reliability, and usability for critical downstream consumers (e.g., Accounting, Finance, SAP/FS).

  • A track record of effectively working with a team of product managers and/or shipping global, impactful software products in complex product landscapes;

  • A technical background and familiarity with data structures;

  • Ability to communicate effectively across all levels of the organization;

  • Ability to lead cross-functional teams successfully;

  • Minimum Years of Relevant Experience: 15+ Years

  • Data Fluent:

    • Can identify and explain the choice of the primary metric, supporting metric and counter metrics

    • Understands what makes a solid hypothesis for experimentation.

    • Understands core experiment statistics e.g. sample size, p-value and test power

    • Understands how to analyse data and present findings to stakeholders and make product decisions with the results.

    • Able to deal with ambiguous and complex data where proxy metrics might be needed.

    • Understands and applies more sophisticated analytical or experimentation techniques (e.g. non-inferiority).

    • Fully understands how their track’s performance connects with the wider business’s financial health and success.


Pre-Employment Screening

If your application is successful, your personal data may be used for a pre-employment screening check by a third party as permitted by applicable law. Depending on the vacancy and applicable law, a pre-employment screening may include employment history, education and other information (such as media information) that may be necessary for determining your qualifications and suitability for the position.

title: Senior Data Databricks Engineer
description:
Be in IT specjalizuje się w kompleksowej rekrutacji specjalistów IT dla polskich i międzynarodowych firm. Wspieramy klientów w pozyskiwaniu ekspertów z obszarów software development, AI, data, cloud, cybersecurity, ERP, CRM oraz zarządzania IT.

Stawiamy na znajomość technologii, przejrzystą komunikację i partnerskie podejście, dzięki którym skutecznie dopasowujemy kandydatów do potrzeb organizacji i realizowanych projektów.

Obecnie dla naszego klienta poszukujemy osoby na stanowisko: Senior Data Databricks Engineer.

Zakres obowiązków:

  • Długofalowa współpraca z międzynarodową, topową firmą consultingową, świadczącą usługi IT dla dużych i średnich firm z różnorodnych sektorów przy projekcie skupionym na budowie i optymalizacji nowoczesnych platform danych w Azure oraz Databricks.

  • Projektowanie, rozwój i utrzymanie skalowalnych pipeline'ów danych oraz przetwarzanie dużych wolumenów danych dla rozwiązań analitycznych, krytycznych dla biznesu.

  • Praca z technologiami PySpark, Delta Lake, Spark SQL oraz Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2.

  • Stosowanie wzorców Slowly Changing Dimensions (SCD) oraz technologii CDC (Change Data Capture) i ładowania przyrostowego.

  • Optymalizacja wydajności Spark w oparciu o wymogi SLA oraz konfiguracja Adaptive Query Execution (AQE).

  • Realizacja wzorców migracji z SSIS do nowoczesnej architektury chmurowej.

Oczekujemy:

  • Znajomość języka angielskiego na poziomie B2 lub C1 – umożliwiająca swobodną komunikację w międzynarodowym środowisku.

  • Gotowość do pracy w modelu hybrydowym (wymagana obecność w biurze klienta 2 dni w tygodniu we Wrocławiu).

Oferujemy:

title: Senior Investment Spokesperson
description:
We’re looking for a Senior Investment Analyst to help build AJ Bell’s profile as a leading voice on investment markets, economics and retail investing.

This is a high profile role for someone who combines strong investment and economic knowledge with the ability to communicate complex topics clearly and engagingly. You’ll act as an AJ Bell brand ambassador and media spokesperson, providing authoritative insight on markets, investment trends and the economy across national, consumer and trade media.

Alongside responding to the daily news agenda, you’ll develop original analysis and thought leadership, create engaging content for our customers and help identify the investment stories and themes that matter to retail investors.

What you’ll be doing

Media and PR

  • Act as a regular spokesperson on investment markets, macroeconomics and investing across TV, radio, national, consumer and trade media.
  • Provide timely, authoritative analysis of market movements, investment trends, economic data and geopolitical developments.
  • Identify compelling investment stories and angles that strengthen AJ Bell’s presence in the national and financial media.
  • Produce clear and engaging commentary in response to market events, economic announcements, regulatory developments and legislative changes.
  • Respond quickly to media requests for expert investment and economic insight.
  • Develop original, data-led analysis and thought leadership on issues affecting investors, producing reports, press releases and supporting content.
  • Develop and contribute to longer-term PR campaigns around key investment and economic themes.
  • Work closely with our Investments, PR, Marketing and Content teams to identify opportunities to grow AJ Bell’s profile and reach new audiences.

Content and customer engagement

  • Produce high-quality investment and market content for the AJ Bell website.
  • Create and present video content explaining investment concepts, market events and economic developments.
  • Contribute regularly to AJ Bell podcasts, webinars and other digital content.
  • Help create engaging educational content that makes investing and financial markets more accessible to retail investors.
  • Provide expert insight for social media and other customer communications where appropriate.

What we’re looking for

You’ll be someone who is genuinely interested in markets, investing and the wider economic environment, but just as importantly, you’ll know how to turn that knowledge into engaging commentary that resonates with customers and the media.

You’ll be comfortable working at pace, responding to breaking market developments and proactively identifying the stories and investment themes that will generate interest.

You’ll also have:

  • Proven experience within investment markets, investment research, asset or wealth management, financial journalism, economics or a closely related field.
  • Strong knowledge of investment markets, asset classes and macroeconomics.
  • A clear understanding of how economic data, monetary policy and geopolitical developments influence financial markets and retail investors.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex financial topics clearly to a broad audience.
  • Experience producing investment analysis, market commentary or financial content for external audiences.
  • A good understanding of retail investing and the issues that matter to individual investors.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and the confidence to build relationships across the business and externally.
  • The ability to work effectively under demanding deadlines in a fast-moving news environment.
  • Excellent attention to detail and strong organisational skills.
  • A proactive, curious approach, with the drive to uncover new ideas, stories and angles.
  • The confidence to represent AJ Bell publicly, including through media interviews, podcasts, webinars and events.

Experience of the investment platform market and an understanding of AJ Bell’s position within it would be advantageous.

It would be great if you also have

  • A professional investment qualification such as CFA, CISI, IMC or equivalent.
  • A degree in economics, finance, investment or a related discipline.
  • Previous experience as a media spokesperson, particularly across TV or radio.
  • Experience presenting webinars, podcasts, panels or public events.

Working pattern

We’re open to applications on either a full-time or part-time basis and welcome interest from experienced investment professionals, economists and financial journalists looking for a more flexible working arrangement.

This is an opportunity to use your investment expertise in a highly visible role, helping shape how AJ Bell talks about markets, economics and investing while making complex financial topics more accessible to millions of UK investors.

About AJ Bell

AJ Bell is one of the UK’s fastest-growing investment platform businesses, providing award-winning solutions for everyone, from professional financial advisers to first-time investors.

Today, over 723,000 customers trust us to manage more than £108.7 billion of assets. By continually striving to make investing simpler and more accessible, we’re helping more people take control of their financial futures.

We’re proud to be recognised as one of the UK’s Best 100 Companies to Work For for six consecutive years, and a Great Place to Work® in 2025 and 2026 a reflection of our supportive and collaborative culture.

What we offer

  • 26 days holiday, increasing with service + buy/sell scheme + bank holidays
  • 7% Pension with matched contributions
  • Discretionary bonus scheme
  • Share schemes (including free shares and BAYE)
  • Health Cash Plan and discounted private healthcare
  • Free onsite gym
  • Enhanced family leave (subject to qualifying criteria)
  • Travel and bike loan schemes
  • Employee Assistance Programme

Life at AJ Bell

  • Regular social events including summer and Christmas parties
  • Learning and development opportunities tailored to you
  • Casual dress code
  • Friendly, supportive team environment

Our ways of working

We offer hybrid working, with a minimum of 50% of your working time per month spent in the office.

For new starters, there’s an initial period of full-time office working to help you settle in and build relationships.

Inclusion & diversity

We’re committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone feels respected and able to be themselves at work.

We welcome applications from all backgrounds and make hiring decisions based on skills, experience and potential.

title: construction Superintendent Commercial Luxury Retail
description:
Construction Superintendent – Commercial Luxury Retail

Company: CPM Builders NA, LLC
Department: Operations
Reports To: Project Manager / Director of Operations
Employment Type: Full-Time
Travel Requirement: Frequent travel and temporary relocation based on project assignments

Position Summary

CPM Builders is seeking an experienced Construction Superintendent to oversee the field execution of high-end commercial and luxury retail construction projects. This position is responsible for daily jobsite operations, subcontractor coordination, schedule management, quality control, safety compliance, and successful project delivery.

The ideal candidate has extensive experience managing fast-paced retail buildouts with sophisticated architectural details, premium finishes, demanding schedules, and strict client standards. The Superintendent must demonstrate strong leadership, exceptional attention to detail, and the ability to communicate effectively with project managers, subcontractors, vendors, clients, designers, architects, mall management, and inspectors.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Jobsite Leadership and Coordination

  • Direct and supervise all daily construction activities at the project site.
  • Coordinate subcontractors, vendors, deliveries, inspections, and workforce requirements.
  • Conduct daily site walks and confirm that work is progressing according to the approved plans, specifications, schedule, and quality standards.
  • Lead daily coordination meetings and communicate priorities, deadlines, access requirements, and site conditions to subcontractors.
  • Maintain a professional, organized, clean, and secure jobsite.
  • Serve as the primary field representative for CPM Builders.
  • Promote teamwork, accountability, professionalism, and respectful communication among all project participants.

Scheduling and Project Execution

  • Review and understand project drawings, specifications, scopes of work, contracts, schedules, and logistical requirements.
  • Develop short-term look-ahead schedules in coordination with the Project Manager.
  • Monitor project milestones, manpower, material availability, and subcontractor performance.
  • Identify potential delays, conflicts, or resource shortages and promptly communicate them to the Project Manager.
  • Implement recovery plans when work falls behind schedule.
  • Coordinate after-hours, overnight, weekend, and phased work when required by the client, landlord, or mall.
  • Support timely completion of punch-list items and project closeout activities.

Quality Control

  • Ensure all work meets CPM Builders’ standards, approved construction documents, applicable building codes, and client expectations.
  • Monitor the installation of high-end millwork, stone, tile, glass, metal, lighting, flooring, ceilings, fixtures, and specialty finishes.
  • Verify field dimensions, layouts, elevations, transitions, alignments, and finish details before installation.
  • Identify deficiencies early and coordinate corrective action before they affect the schedule or other trades.
  • Protect completed work and ensure appropriate care is taken with premium materials and finishes.
  • Maintain current drawings, approved submittals, samples, and project documentation at the jobsite.

Safety and Compliance

  • Enforce all company, client, landlord, OSHA, and site-specific safety requirements.
  • Conduct daily safety inspections, toolbox talks, and required jobsite orientations.
  • Confirm that workers use the required personal protective equipment.
  • Immediately document and report accidents, injuries, unsafe conditions, property damage, and near-miss incidents.
  • Maintain required safety records, permits, postings, inspection reports, and documentation.
  • Coordinate with the company’s safety team to correct hazards and maintain a safe working environment.
  • Confirm that subcontractors are properly authorized and compliant before beginning work.

Documentation and Communication

  • Prepare accurate daily reports documenting manpower, completed work, deliveries, inspections, site conditions, delays, safety matters, and photographs.
  • Maintain records of field directives, conversations, inspections, deficiencies, and corrective actions.
  • Review drawings and submit requests for information when clarification is needed.
  • Promptly communicate project risks, changes, unforeseen conditions, and potential cost impacts to the Project Manager.
  • Participate in project meetings and provide clear field-status updates.
  • Maintain organized project records throughout construction.
  • Assist with inspections, turnover documentation, closeout requirements, and client handover.

Materials and Site Logistics

  • Coordinate deliveries, staging, storage, and protection of materials.
  • Verify materials upon arrival for quantity, condition, and compliance with approved selections.
  • Immediately report damaged, incorrect, incomplete, or missing materials.
  • Plan jobsite access, loading, trash removal, temporary protection, and material movement.
  • Coordinate work in occupied spaces or active retail environments while minimizing disruption to customers, tenants, and neighboring businesses.
  • Ensure company tools, equipment, keys, access credentials, and project materials are properly controlled.

Minimum Qualifications

  • At least five years of construction field supervision experience, preferably in commercial interiors, retail construction, or high-end tenant improvements.
  • Demonstrated experience successfully completing luxury retail stores or similarly detailed commercial projects.
  • Strong knowledge of construction methods, sequencing, building systems, codes, inspections, and jobsite safety.
  • Ability to read and interpret architectural, structural, mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and shop drawings.
  • Experience managing multiple subcontractors in fast-paced and deadline-driven environments.
  • Strong organizational, leadership, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to prepare clear daily reports and maintain accurate project documentation.
  • Working knowledge of construction technology, email, mobile applications, and project-management platforms.
  • Ability to work independently while maintaining consistent communication with the Project Manager and leadership team.
  • Valid driver’s license and a driving record acceptable under company requirements.
  • Reliable transportation.
  • Ability to pass all required employment screenings.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bilingual proficiency in English and Spanish is strongly preferred.
  • OSHA 30-Hour Construction certification.
  • First Aid and CPR certification.
  • Experience working with luxury retail brands, shopping centers, malls, flagship stores, or occupied commercial spaces.
  • Experience coordinating inspections and working with architects, designers, mall management, and client representatives.
  • Familiarity with Procore, Bluebeam, Microsoft Office, and construction scheduling software.

Travel and Schedule Requirements

  • Must be available to travel and temporarily relocate based on project assignments.
  • Must be available to work days, nights, weekends, holidays, and extended hours when required by the project schedule.
  • Must be able to respond to urgent jobsite matters outside regular working hours.
  • Project schedules and locations may change according to operational and client needs.

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to regularly walk active construction sites and navigate stairs, ladders, scaffolding, uneven surfaces, and confined areas.
  • Ability to stand or walk for extended periods.

title: Utbildningsanställning specialistsjuksköterska anestesisjukvård Mora/Falun
description:
Hos oss i Region Dalarna får du ett meningsfullt arbete där du kan göra skillnad. Tillsammans arbetar vi för ett hållbart Dalarna med utvecklingskraft i länets alla delar.

Om verksamheten

Op/An/IVA Falun - På Operation Anestesi IVA kliniken Falun finns två op-avdelningar: Centraloperation med tolv op-salar, varav en robotsal och en hybridsal. Som anestesisjuksköterska söver vi även på ÖNH operation som har egna op-salar. Dagkirurgi Falun har fem op-salar. Både Centraloperation och Dagkirurgin har egna uppvakningsavdelningar. Op-salarna är fördelade mellan regionens opererande kliniker inom akut och elektiv verksamhet.

Op/An/IVA Mora - På Mora lasarett finns två op-avdelningar: Centraloperation, med fem op-salar, och Dagkirurgen, med två op-salar. Op-salarna är fördelade mellan regionens opererande kliniker inom både akut och elektiv verksamhet.

Enheternas gemensamma uppdrag är att tillgodose medborgarnas behov av operationssjukvård och anestesi vid olika ingrepp och undersökningar. Vi strävar efter en hög och jämn produktion med god tillgänglighet och vill skapa attraktiva arbetsplatser med stort fokus på en bra arbetsmiljö och patientsäker vård.

Arbetsuppgifter

Vill du arbeta som specialistsjuksköterska inom anestesisjukvård? Sök då tjänsten hos oss!

Arbetet som anestesisjuksköterska innebär en spännande kombination av perioperativ omvårdnad och högteknologi. Du befinner dig i händelsernas centrum som en viktig kugge i operationsteamet där olika professioner arbetar tillsammans för patientens bästa. Som anestesisjuksköterska har du ett självständigt ansvar för den anestesiologiska omvårdnaden vilket innebär att du i nära samarbete med och på ordination av anestesiolog:

  • planerar och utför generella anestesier
  • övervakar vid regionala och lokala anestesier
  • sederar patienter vid undersökningar och behandlingar
  • övervakar och vårdar patienter i det postoperativa förloppet

I arbetet som anestesisjuksköterska kan du, beroende på placering, komma att ingå i larmkedjan för akuta händelser på sjukhuset och åka på patienttransporter där en högre vårdnivå krävs. Våra patienter är i alla åldrar och vi arbetar dygnet runt.

Är Du den vi söker och vill ta dig an utmaningen att i framtiden axla rollen som anestesisjuksköterska hos oss?

Du behöver själv söka till högskola och efter antagning erhåller du en tillsvidareanställning som sjuksköterska på Op/An/IVA kliniken Falun eller Op/An/IVA kliniken Mora. Efter godkänd specialistutbildning som anestesisjuksköterska placeras du, utifrån verksamheternas behov, på någon av op-avdelningarna på respektive lasarett. Under sommaruppehållet mellan terminerna arbetar du som sjuksköterska inom respektive enhets egen eller närliggande verksamhet samt erhåller sommarsemester.

Kom ihåg! Att läsa en specialistutbildning är en investering i dig själv, en personlig kompetensutveckling du kan nyttja hela ditt arbetsliv.

Vill Du läsa mer om vad yrket innebär? Tryck på länken nedan:

Kompetensbeskrivning-Anestesi.pdf (aniva.se)

Kvalifikationer

Vi söker Dig som är legitimerad sjuksköterska med kandidatexamen i vårdvetenskap alternativt omvårdnad eller sjuksköterskeexamen 180 hp inkl 15 hp examensarbete eller motsvarande. Du är trygg i din yrkesroll och har några års yrkeserfarenhet som sjuksköterska. Erfarenhet från somatisk slutenvård och perioperativ vård är meriterande.

Som person ska Du vara flexibel och stabil med god förmåga att hantera stress. Vi värdesätter engagemang och noggrannhet. Som anestesisjuksköterska ligger du steget före och har beredskap för att situationen kring patienten snabbt kan förändras. Då vi arbetar mycket i team, är det av stor vikt med god samarbetsförmåga med alla yrkeskategorier som finns kring patienten. Vi arbetar personcentrerat med fokus på att patienten ska få en god vård, en bra upplevelse och gott bemötande i sin vårdkontakt med oss. Stor vikt kommer att läggas vid personlig lämplighet och tidigare referenser.

Bifoga följande i din ansökan:

  • kopia av betyg och legitimation som styrker förkunskapskraven.
  • personligt brev som beskriver varför du är intresserad av att studera till specialistsjuksköterska, vad du tänker om att studera på avancerad nivå, samt hur du tänker dig att den kommande yrkesrollen blir.
  • rekommendationsbrev från din nuvarande chef.
  • två arbetsgivarföreträdare för referenser.

Din ansökan ska ha kommit in till Region Dalarna senast den: 15 september 2026. Observera att du också behöver ansöka till utbildningen via https://www.antagning.se , även där är sista ansökningsdag 15 september.

Då Region Dalarna har ett avtal med Högskolan i Gävle ser vi gärna att du söker: Specialistsjuksköterskeprogrammet - inriktning anestesisjukvård 60hp, studieort Falun. Du kommer då även att erbjudas VFU plats inom Region Dalarna.

Utbildningsanställningarna erbjuds under förutsättning att erforderliga beslut fattas kring finansiering och anställning.

Ansökan
  • Har du skyddade personuppgifter ska du inte ansöka via systemet, utan kontakta rekryterande chef direkt
  • Vi tar interna referenser på nuvarande och tidigare anställda i Region Dalarna

title: Senior Data Scientist – Business Analytics - AI
description:
ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.

At AMD, we believe technology can change lives for the better. It can heal us, entertain us, and make us more connected, productive, and understanding of the world around us. And we’re looking for talent who feel the same: people who want to leave the planet better than they found it, those who don’t shy away from humanity’s challenges but are determined to help solve them.

AMD is powering the next generation of supercomputing, high-performance computing, cloud, and AI. Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or creating go-to-market plans, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward.




Job Summary

The Senior Data Scientist – Business Analytics & AI is a senior individual contributor role responsible for driving data-driven decision making through advanced analytics, machine learning, and intelligent automation. This role partners closely with cross-functional teams to deliver scalable analytics solutions, predictive insights, and AI-enabled capabilities across business and financial domains.

Key Responsibilities

Data Science & Advanced Analytics

  • Perform advanced business and financial analysis, including trend analysis, variance analysis, and scenario modeling.
  • Support forecasting, revenue analysis, and performance tracking across multiple business dimensions.
  • Build, test, and refine machine learning models to improve forecasting accuracy and predictive insights.
  • Apply statistical, predictive, and ML techniques to large, complex datasets.
  • Evaluate model performance, interpret results, and communicate insights to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Continuously evolve analytics from descriptive to predictive and prescriptive use cases.

Automation & AI Enablement

  • Identify opportunities to automate recurring analytical processes using AI, ML, and scripting tools.
  • Develop intelligent solutions that reduce manual effort and improve speed, scalability, and reliability.
  • Contribute to AI-driven insights, alerts, and decision-support capabilities embedded in analytics workflows.

Dashboarding & Reporting

  • Design, build, and maintain interactive dashboards and reporting solutions using Power BI.
  • Develop and optimize SQL-based data models to support reporting, analytics, and self-service insights.
  • Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and performance across dashboards and reporting assets.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Communicate findings, recommendations, and technical concepts clearly to diverse audiences.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

  • Hands-on experience with Power BI or similar data visualization tools.
  • Solid understanding of forecasting, revenue, and financial concepts.
  • Experience applying machine learning techniques to business or financial problems.
  • Strong problem-solving and communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building and deploying ML models for forecasting or predictive analytics.
  • Proficiency in Python, R, or similar languages for data science and automation.
  • Experience applying AI-based automation to analytics or reporting workflows.
  • Experience working in a global, matrixed organization.
  • Technology or data-intensive industry experience.

title: Assistant Community Director
description:
About the Role
The Assistant Community Director (ACD) supports the Community Director in overseeing daily property operations with a primary focus on rent collection, financial reporting, and operational accuracy. This role also assists with leasing, marketing, resident relations, and team coordination to ensure the community meets occupancy, revenue, and service goals while delivering an exceptional resident experience.
The ACD works closely with the onsite team to support performance, compliance, and a positive community culture.

What You’ll Do
Financial & Collections Responsibilities
• Lead and support rent collection efforts, ensuring timely and accurate posting of payments and follow-up on delinquent accounts in accordance with company policy and applicable laws.
• Assist with financial reporting, reconciliations, and month-end accounting activities.
• Monitor resident accounts, identify discrepancies, and escalate issues appropriately to the Community Director.
• Support budgeting and operational efficiency through accurate tracking of revenue and performance metrics.
Leasing & Resident Relations
• Assist with leasing activities, including tours, application processing, applicant qualification, and lease preparation.
• Oversee lease renewals and retention efforts to support occupancy and resident satisfaction.
• Build strong relationships with residents and provide exceptional customer service in addressing questions or concerns.
• Serve as a resource for residents and support resolution of issues in collaboration with leasing and maintenance teams.
Marketing & Community Presence
• Support marketing efforts and maintain the community’s online and local presence to attract qualified prospects.
• Participate in resident events and community engagement initiatives to foster a strong sense of community.

Team Coordination & Compliance
• Collaborate with leasing and service teams to ensure smooth daily operations, unit readiness, and timely resolution of resident issues.
• Ensure compliance with Fair Housing laws, company policies, and local/state regulations.
• Assist with onboarding and training of team members as directed by the Community Director.
• Represent Acme Residential professionally in all interactions and support the Community Director with daily operations and special projects.
Operational & Performance Expectations
The Assistant Community Director contributes directly to the financial and operational success of the community by supporting the following benchmarks:
• Support monthly revenue and rent collection goals.
• Assist the onsite team in achieving year-to-date Net Operating Income (NOI) goals.
• Coordinate with maintenance and leasing teams to ensure units are move-in ready according to property schedules.
• Perform daily responsibilities in a manner that supports quarterly financial commitments, operational standards, and resident satisfaction.
• Help maintain:

  • Physical Occupancy of 95% or greater
  • Economic Occupancy of 90% or greater
  • Rent collections of 95% or greater

Other Duties
• Support the Community Director with daily operations, reporting, and assigned projects.
• Represent Acme Residential with professionalism, integrity, and a resident-first mindset.
• Perform other duties as assigned to support property operations.

What You Bring
• 2+ years of multifamily property management experience, with collections or financial responsibilities preferred.
• Bachelor’s degree preferred.
• Experience with Yardi Voyager and/or Rent Café CRM IQ preferred.
• Strong communication, organizational, and relationship-building skills.
• Knowledge of Fair Housing laws and ability to apply state and local regulations.
• Ownership mindset; treat the community as your own business and demonstrate initiative in improving operations and resident experience.
• Experience with distressed or value-add properties a plus.
• Positive attitude, professional demeanor, and commitment to personal and team growth.
• Ability to work flexible hours, including some evenings and weekends.

Physical Requirements
The physical demands described below are representative of those that must be met to successfully perform the essential functions of this role. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform these functions.
• Ability to sit or stand for extended periods while performing administrative and resident service duties.
• Ability to walk the property for extended periods, including use of stairs and uneven surfaces.
• Ability to occasionally lift, carry, push, or pull items weighing up to 25 pounds.
• Ability to perform ongoing computer-based work, including data entry and electronic communication.
• Ability to communicate clearly and professionally in person, by phone, and in writing.
• Ability to work both in an office setting and throughout the residential community, including entering residential units as needed.
• Minimal travel is required, limited to onboarding and occasional training at the corporate office in Bloomfield Hills or training sites within the Metro Detroit area (e.g., Warren, Troy).

Why You’ll Love Working Here
Join Acme Residential, where we invest in our people just as much as our properties. We offer career growth, a supportive team environment, and one of the best benefit packages in the industry.

  • Competitive pay
  • Bonus & commission opportunities
  • Generous paid time off (vacation, holidays, sick, parental leave)
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Employee housing discounts
  • Medical, dental & vision coverage
  • FSA, pet insurance, tuition reimbursement
  • Career development, paid training, & employee recognition programs

This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

title: Food/Drink Runner Full-Time Naperville
description:
Fun and fast paced, join the “Hospitality Support Team” as a food/drink runner in a position that helps make each shift feel smooth and efficient.


The “Hospitality Support Team” includes the host, food runner/drink runner, barista, and busser roles. Hospitality Support Team members will enhance the guest experience by supporting the front of house servers to make and deliver drinks, deliver food, accommodate guests coming in, clear tables, keep the dining area clean and organized, etc.


At Egg Harbor, we are committed to building an ever-growing base of regular customers in the communities that we serve. We do this by maintaining our standard of excellence, providing a warm and family-friendly atmosphere, and serving a wide variety of food. As part of our team, you will be integral in our goal. When asked “Where should we go to eat?” We want Egg Harbor to be the first and unanimous answer. You are integral in us achieving this goal. You will work as part of a team, having new and inspiring interactions with guests and team members alike daily. All this leading to both you and our customers leaving Egg Harbor every day feeling fulfilled, accomplished, and excited to return tomorrow.


Shifts start and end early, so you’ll never work at night. Scheduling is generally flexible if you understand that our busiest days are on the weekends and holidays. We are closed on Thanksgiving and Christmas Day.


If you are someone who enjoys working in a team-oriented environment, is responsible, trustworthy, prompt, reliable, and self-motivated, then you would be a great fit for the Egg Harbor Café Team.


In the role of food/drink runner, your job responsibilities would be (but not limited to):

  • Ensure the efficient flow of food and drink orders from the wait staff to the kitchen
  • Check receipts and assemble the order for the guest
  • Ensure orders are being prepared with the correct priority and alert management to quality issues or long wait times
  • Ensure that the food and drink presentation is fresh and up to quality standards
  • Assist in the final plate or drink presentation (e.g. adding condiments and/or toppings)
  • Check dishes/drinks before delivery for accuracy, presentation, and temperature
  • Deliver orders quickly to customers to maintain fast service
  • Communicate important information to the kitchen and the wait staff (e.g. when a customer has a particular request)
  • Keep Runner/Expo area clean and well stocked
  • Eliminate obstacles in service, food preparation lines, or dishwashing
  • Inspect the premises according to quality and sanitation standards, and assist in cleaning
  • Maintain working area is safe and clean; sweep/mop as needed
  • Handle complaints from customers to preserve the restaurant’s reputation of providing excellent customer service
  • Support other tasks as needed (i.e., organizing and bagging to-go orders)
  • Perform other related duties as assigned
  • Perform opening/closing and on shift side work and maintenance properly

Perks of the Job:

Flexible schedule, holiday bonus, PTO, employee scholarship program, meal discounts, shifts end early (restaurant closes at 2pm), family owned (never franchised), employee assistance program, etc

Company Information:

In the fast-paced world of digital infrastructure, SRI leverages over 25 years of experience to help organizations deploy, integrate, and maintain cutting-edge data center environments. We specialize in rapid equipment deployments providing rack-and-stack, cable integration, equipment configuration, test, migration, and decom services. SRI partners with leading cloud providers and enterprise data center operators to build high-performance, scalable infrastructure solutions. Our exclusive focus on industry-leading clients ensures we remain at the forefront of technology, delivering innovative results for every project.

Benefits

SRI offers W-2 employment with access to a comprehensive benefit packages that include Paid Time Off, Paid Holidays, Health/Dental/Vision Insurance, 401k, HSA, and more.

Salary

$21- $40/hr. based on skill level / experience

Description of Role

SRI is hiring skilled Integration Technicians experienced in ISP / Central Office / Headend / Data Center network facilities to support the deployment and maintenance of high-performance network environments across the nation. This role goes beyond standard rack-and-stack work - we're looking for techs with deep knowledge in structured cabling, RF systems, and fiber integration who can work confidently in headend, central office, and enterprise data center settings. With a clear growth path from Level 1 to Level 4, this position is ideal for professionals who take pride in precise, standards-based installs and thrive in critical network facility environments.

Core Responsibilities (All Levels):

  • Deliver high-quality infrastructure installations and on-site support that exceed customer expectations
  • Adhere to safety standards and best practices for data center and network facility deployments
  • Work independently or with senior technicians depending on experience level
  • Demonstrate growing expertise in mechanical/electrical assembly and cabling
  • Participate in network integrations, migrations, and cutovers - including off-hours shifts when needed

Skill Progression Levels:

Skill Level 1 - Technician - Entry

  • New to digital infrastructure / network facility support or returning after 2+ years away from the industry.
  • Works under direct supervision of Level 3 or 4 Technicians.
  • Identifies and properly uses hand tools and PPE.
  • Performs mechanical and electrical assembly of non-powered/passive equipment and / or hardware.
  • Assists with basic network cabling tasks under guidance.
  • Not authorized to work on live data circuits or powered equipment without supervision.
  • Must complete a minimum of 1.5 years or show equivalent proficiency for advancement.

Skill Level 2 - Technician

  • 1.5+ years of digital infrastructure / network facility support experience or equivalent proven proficiency.
  • Proficient in all Level 1 tasks and begins independent work on passive systems.
  • Completes cabinet/rack installation, cable management (ironwork, ladder rack, fiber duct), and grounding.
  • Installs and dresses CAT5/6 and fiber network cabling.
  • Performs basic network cable testing and basic DC power installation.
  • Adds/removes cabling on non-working equipment only.
  • Supports network testing and fiber prep work in network facilities.
  • Advancement requires 2 years experience or proficiency assessment.

Skill Level 3 - Lead Technician

  • 2+ years of digital infrastructure experience and proficient in Level 1 & 2 responsibilities.
  • Capable of leading installation / integration team members and assigning tasks to junior techs.
  • Performs secondary DC power installations and prepares MOPs.
  • Resolves documentation discrepancies and ensures quality inspections.
  • Troubleshoots network issues with test equipment.
  • Supports migrations and software upgrades in network facilities.
  • Analyzes project documentation to plan installation approach and materials.
  • Interfaces with internal and external teams to support project execution.
  • Must be approved for advancement by Operations Management based on documented performance.

Skill Level 4 - Senior Technician / Field Manager

  • 3+ years of digital infrastructure experience and expert-level proficiency.
  • Leads complex installations and migrations in network facilities.
  • Installs and verifies both secondary and (with supervision) primary DC power systems.
  • Adds/removes power circuits on working power distribution systems and performs power transitions.
  • Configures and turns up network facility equipment including advanced OEM platforms.
  • Performs software upgrades, signal modifications, and system-level testing.
  • Contributes to engineering and design discussions, including EF&I standards.
  • Mentors junior staff and evaluates skill progression using GR-1275-CORE.
  • Ensures all documentation, labeling, and testing meets company and industry standards.

Required Skills:

  • Physically capable of lifting up to 80 lbs and safely working on ladders or in confined spaces
  • Strong situational awareness and attention to detail in high-stakes environments
  • Excellent communication, organization, and time management skills
  • Familiarity with Excel, PowerPoint, and data analysis/reporting tools
  • Self-driven and dependable, with the ability to work independently, including night shifts as needed

Work Schedule

Monday through Friday with some overnight work performing equipment migrations

Location: Tyler, TX

title: Dog Welfare Assistant (15 hours)
description:
Have you always had an itch to scratch when it comes to helping dogs? We’re looking for someone with a commitment to animal welfare to join the team in our busy rehoming centre.
Dog Welfare Assistants are the backbone of our centres, as they care for our four-legged friends every day. We’re looking for someone who can provide our dogs with the highest level of care and enrichment, as they prepare for their forever home.
As Dog Welfare Assistant, you’ll:
  • provide daily care to the dogs in the rehoming centre, working to Dogs Trust's code of practice and Health and Safety guidelines,
  • educate potential new owners and the general public on the care and welfare of their dogs,
  • deliver excellent customer service to all visitors to the centre.
The successful candidate will be an excellent communicator with the ability to show empathy to both people and animals. A strong team player, you'll have lots of energy and a positive upbeat attitude. Experienced in working with or handling dogs, you'll be knowledgeable in basic behaviour and health issues and, above all, be committed to the aims and objectives of Dogs Trust. A full, manual driving licence is also essential, as driving will be a part of the role.
Our rehoming centres house thousands of dogs each year until they can find a loving new home and the success of our centres wouldn’t be possible without our dedicated team of staff and volunteers; there is a real family-community within each of our centres. Come rain or shine, our team are out in all weathers to make sure the dogs have the best possible life. Dealing with thousands of visitors each month, our rehoming centres are the face of Dogs Trust, and we pride ourselves on our staff providing the very best in customer service.

This is a Part Time role working 15 hours.

Physical Demands. The team member is frequently require to bend over, twist, reach above shoulder level, crouch or stoop, kneel, repetitively use feet, and use head and neck in a twisting or static motion and to look up and/or down, and lift and/or move up to 50 pounds. Occasionally, the team member is required to sit, climb, balance, push and/or pull, and lift and/or move over 51 pounds.

Work Environment. While performing the duties of this job, the team member is required to work outdoors in various temperatures, in a noisy environment, near moving mechanical parts, with dangerous equipment or sharp tools, and around fumes, odors, dust, or toxic chemicals.

title: Power Management Architecture and Performance Modeling Engineer
description:
WHAT YOU DO AT AMD CHANGES EVERYTHING

At AMD, our mission is to build great products that accelerate next-generation computing experiences—from AI and data centers, to PCs, gaming and embedded systems. Grounded in a culture of innovation and collaboration, we believe real progress comes from bold ideas, human ingenuity and a shared passion to create something extraordinary. When you join AMD, you’ll discover the real differentiator is our culture. We push the limits of innovation to solve the world’s most important challenges—striving for execution excellence, while being direct, humble, collaborative, and inclusive of diverse perspectives. Join us as we shape the future of AI and beyond. Together, we advance your career.

THE ROLE:

AMD's Datacenter Performance Group is seeking an Engineer for Power Management Architecture and Power and Performance Modeling to support the Power Constrained Performance of our industry-leading AI/ML/HPC GPUs. The role will involve contributing to the Perf@Power attainment of a leading generation of our Instinct accelerators, working closely with a cross-functional team that drives key aspects of Perf@Power attainment, including pre-Si modeling, post-Si correlation, workload analysis, PPA target setting and attainment tracking, power/perf roll-ups and reporting, and methodology development. Being passionate about performance and power efficiency, strong analytical skills, and effective communication are key ingredients for success in this role.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Support power-constrained performance modeling, projections, target setting, and attainment tracking from Concept-exit (pre-Si) to Product launch (post-Si) for AMD Instinct AI/ML/HPC accelerators
  • Contribute to power management architecture definition across multiple levels, including:
    • Firmware-based power management features (e.g., SMU-driven power/thermal control, power state management)
    • AVFS (Adaptive Voltage and Frequency Scaling) technologies, including RTAVFS, to reduce voltage/frequency margin based on real-time feedback
    • Micro-architecture level power features (e.g., clock gating, power gating, dynamic voltage/frequency scaling, p-states)
    • Macro-architecture level power features (e.g., power domains, power delivery partitioning, on-die voltage regulation)
    • SoC-level power management and power capping features
    • Rack-level and Datacenter-level power management and orchestration features
  • Develop and maintain power and performance models to support Cdyn/Leakage/STA/Area trade-off analysis and attainment
  • Create state-of-the-art ML-based modeling solutions to improve accuracy, speed, and scalability of power and performance predictions across pre-Si and post-Si stages
  • Explore and apply advanced ML techniques (e.g., regression, gradient boosting, neural networks) to model power/performance behavior, automate correlation between pre-Si projections and post-Si silicon data, and accelerate workload power analysis
  • Collaborate with product architecture and business unit teams to help define product configurations, capabilities, and P&P targets
  • Work cross-functionally with SOC architecture, System Design, IP Design, Circuit Design, Foundry team, CAD, Physical Design, Software, Firmware, Power Management, and Post-Si validation teams to support P&P attainment
  • Assist with power/performance roll-ups and readouts, and help drive awareness of power efficiency improvements across teams
  • Support post-Si power/performance debug and calibration of pre-Si models against silicon data
  • Contribute to workload power analysis and help evolve methodologies for key PPA domains

KEY QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Background in Computer Architecture, Processor/Accelerator development, or Power Management Architecture
  • Experience or strong interest in firmware-based power management, AVFS technologies, and power features spanning micro-architecture, macro-architecture, SoC, Rack, and Datacenter levels
  • Experience or strong interest in power/performance projections, modeling, and optimization at the SoC or system level
  • Familiarity with digital logic physical design and power management techniques (clock gating, power gating, V-F curves, p-states, on-die voltage regulation, clock integrity, etc.)
  • Familiarity with post-silicon power/performance debug and model correlation is a plus
  • Good communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with various engineering teams
  • Familiarity with fundamentals of Machine Learning and hands-on experience with model building is a bonus, with interest in developing new, state-of-the-art ML-based modeling solutions for power and performance prediction
  • Knowledge of DL/ML/LLM/MoE workloads will be a bonus

EDUCATION:

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related field

This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship.

title: Corrections Technician [FT]
description:
Mirror follows affirmative action policies and is committed to providing equal opportunities to all qualified candidates. EEO/Veterans/Disabled are encouraged to apply.

A Corrections Technician performs duties under the supervision of the Mirror Federal Programs Director and Chief of Security at the Residential Reentry Center (RRC.) Technicians play a key role to ensuring programs and operations offered by Mirror to its contracting authorities (Federal Bureau of Prisons (BOP)) are fulfilled in an accurate and consistent manner. The Corrections Technician shall operate in an ethical, professional manner, interact with others in such a fashion as to create and maintain respect for Mirror and our funding source (i.e., BOP.) They should be familiar with the statement of work and the contractual provisions set forth in the agreement with BOP. They shall act in accordance with the policies determined by the Board of Directors and shall abide by all applicable federal, state and local regulations. In short, the duties of this position include supervision of federal residents, documenting resident behavior in the agencys electronic data management system, clerical tasks as related to the work environment, security of the facility, fostering the accountability of residents, collection and the related paperwork requirements of resident urinalysis testing, and assisting other staff whenever needed.

Duties and Responsibilities:

1. Supervise residents during the assigned hours per the agencys accountability standards.

2. Monitor and engage with residents as required.

3. Provide training and presentations to residents and supervise recreational activities as directed by your supervisor.

4. Familiarize yourself daily with the status of each individual resident through daily briefings with staff and reviewing the facility log. Staff must ensure they are prepared for their shift by being properly informed of issues which may impact their workday (i.e., emails, shift log, directives from supervisors.)

5. Complete orientation related paperwork on each new resident as directed by your supervisor.

6. When directed by your supervisor, provide transportation for residents to community-based providers. This might include appointments to court hearings, doctors offices, mental health providers, etc...

7. Maintain a record of all resident movement within the given facility.

8. Maintain resident and program confidentiality as required by federal law.

9. Supervise and observe residents during the urine specimen collection process.

10. Notify the appropriate supervisor if a resident fails to provide a urine sample when required.

11. Ensure the safety of the residents served by the Residential Reentry Center residential building while you are on duty.

12. Monitor residents as necessary when on Mirror property, at Mirror related activities in the community or while at scheduled appointments with community providers.

13. While on duty, maintain a true and accurate record of residents movement and behavior and of other program related activities on the forms provided by Mirror or within the agencys electronic data management system.

14. Must attend and participate in all staff meetings as directed by the Mirror Federal Programs Director.

15. Assure copies of all official program communications and resident related materials are filed appropriately and in the designated resident files.

16. Complete required documents and processes as outlined in policy, operations manual, and direction from supervisory staff.

17. Handle crisis situations as they might arise. Intervene appropriately to diffuse or de-escalate potentially harmful situations.

18. Be available for case staffing conferences and staff meetings when scheduled by your supervisor.

19. Record and deposit resident subsistence, which is collected via the policy and procedures, set forth by the agency. Assist in the collection of subsistence as it directly impacts the relationship between the resident and BOP.

20. Assist Mirror's program and administrative staff with BOP compliance and audit conditions.

21. Supervise resident clean-up of kitchen facilities, living areas, and common spaces located in and surrounding the facility.

22. Perform other job-related functions as directed by your immediate supervisor.

Job Summary

The Patient Representative Coordinator (PRC) is the first point of contact for patients and visitors, ensuring a welcoming and professional experience. This role supports the patient journey through pre-visit planning, check-in, check-out, and post-visit follow-up while maintaining accurate records, protecting confidentiality, and complying with organizational and regulatory standards.   • For scheduled and walk - in patients, perform the check -in process; verify the patient’s scheduled appointment and visit type in eCW; scan and uploads identification and insurance cards; print and scan the Patient Registration Form; validate insurance eligibility; collect required copayments; update demographic information by asking the patient the required information (email, phone, address) in eCW; collect consents when applicable and update the visit status to confirm check-in completion.

title: Biobank Director
description:
Department

BSD SRF - Human Tissue Resource Center


About the Department

The Human Tissue Resource Center (HTRC) Biobank unit is a pathology-based, CAP-accredited core facility. It provides effective procurement, storage, distribution, and analysis of human biospecimens that are of critical importance to biomedical research. The HTRC Biobank provides investigators with a centralized infrastructure to optimize the efficiency and costs related to research involving human biospecimens. The core provides a coordinated, centralized, and dedicated program for the procurement, processing, dispersing, and assessment of all types of biospecimens. It is a BSD core part of the Office of Shared Research Facilities.


Job Summary

The Biobank Director provides strategic, operational, and regulatory leadership for the institution's biobanking program, overseeing the collection, processing, storage, management, and distribution of human biospecimens to support research. This role directs biobank operations, including laboratory activities, quality systems, personnel, biospecimen lifecycle management, infrastructure, and fee-for-service programs, while ensuring compliance with institutional policies, IRB requirements, CAP standards, and applicable regulations. Working collaboratively with investigators, clinical teams, research administration, and external partners, the Biobank Director advances operational excellence, develops standardized processes, and supports institutional research priorities through high-quality, sustainable biobanking services.

This at-will position is wholly or partially funded by contractual grant funding which is renewed under provisions set by the grantor of the contract. Employment will be contingent upon the continued receipt of these grant funds and satisfactory job performance.

Responsibilities

  • In partnership with the Faculty Director, develops and executes the strategic vision for the biobank, ensuring alignment with institutional research priorities.

  • Identifies opportunities for program growth, new services, technology implementation, and operational efficiencies. Represents the biobank on institutional committees, external collaborations, and professional organizations.

  • Supports research initiatives and business development activities related to biospecimen services.

  • Directs laboratory facility operations, including equipment procurement, vendor management, service contracts, and infrastructure planning.

  • Collaborates with HTRC Histology and Faculty Director to troubleshoot technical and administrative challenges and implementing effective resolutions.

  • Leads daily biospecimen operations, including tissue collection, as well as processing, storage, and shipment of tissue and biofluids.

  • Aligns biobanking operations, resources, and strategic priorities with institutional research objectives and evolving clinical research needs.

  • Partners with researchers to develop, implement, and update biospecimen banking protocols and Institutional Review Board (IRB) submissions.

  • Provides operational and regulatory guidance to investigators on long-term research initiatives, biospecimen utilization, and departmental strategy.

  • Serves as a key institutional contact for inspections, safety audits, and compliance reviews. Oversees data compliance reporting and monitoring activities.

  • Oversees the Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS), LabVantage, ensuring system integrity, data quality, regulatory compliance, and optimization of biobanking workflows.

  • Oversees the functionality, maintenance, validation, and repair of laboratory equipment; evaluates operational needs and recommends equipment acquisitions and capital funding requests.

  • Directs laboratory facility operations, including equipment procurement, vendor management, service contracts, and infrastructure planning.

  • Ensures biobanking operations and procedures comply with College of American Pathologists (CAP) and institutional requirements, and all applicable policies and procedures.

  • Leads the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of standard operating procedures, workflows, and technical processes to improve efficiency and research quality. Directs all CAP accreditation activities, including inspection readiness, execution of inspections, and oversight of corrective actions and remediation of findings.

  • Partners with Human Resources to support recruitment, hiring, onboarding, and professional development; manages employee relations mattering including performance management, compensation, and staff engagement.

  • Develops organizational structure, staffing models, succession planning, and workforce development strategies to support current and future biobanking needs.

  • Manages research professionals and support staff involved with planning, monitoring, and compliance aspects of research projects. Advises other researchers on long-range plans for research projects.

  • Develops goals and operating procedures, practices, and guidelines for research activity based on department strategy.

  • Manages the laboratory facilities, including the purchase of new equipment and the maintenance and repair of laboratory equipment.

  • Reviews research of others, and may conduct own research, in area of expertise. Edits and approves articles, reports and manuscripts. Presents research findings at meetings and/or conferences. Manages the research of processes in clinical or non-clinical settings. Program and use computers to store, process, and analyze data.

  • Performs other related work as needed.

Minimum requirements include a college or university degree in related field.

  • 7+ years of experience operating and managing core facilities/research or clinical laboratories.

  • Experience with LabVantage LIM system.

Licenses and Certifications:

  • American Society for Clinical Pathology (ASCP) certification.

title: Shift Leader
description:
Summary

Supervise shifts and/or work areas in the operation of a Papa John's restaurant to ensure high-quality products and customer service are delivered to ensure restaurant profitability. Other responsibilities include the management of operations including the execution of all Company policies, procedures, programs, and systems. Ensure compliance with all federal, state, and local laws and ethical business practices.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities include the following. Other duties may be assigned.

  • Demonstrate exemplary operations skills in all aspects of the restaurant including making quality products for our customers and ensuring each delivered product meets Papa John's standards and accurately reflects the customer's order. Professionally and promptly respond to all customer concerns or issues. Solicit customer feedback, share feedback with team, and use feedback to improve restaurant operations and build brand loyalty. Communicate, train, and promote quality standards to team members by utilizing all available tools including Operations Manual and Team Member Handbook.
  • Supervise a restaurant team, maintain adequate shift staffing levels according to projected sales, properly train team members to exceed customer expectations, ensure compliance with uniform and appearance standards, and coach for improved performance. Ensure team is quality and customer-focused and build an atmosphere of teamwork, energy, and fun.
  • Contribute to sales goals by providing prompt and friendly customer service; building check averages through team member product training and sales execution.
  • Contribute to profit goals by ensuring they stay within company guidelines and target goals by accurately utilizing the PROFIT System. Execute cash management duties. Assist in the management of adequate inventory levels using the company's systems and guidelines to minimize loss. Manage company's assets by ensuring the restaurant is clean, safe, and organized; complies with safety and security standards at all times.

Position Qualifications. To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.

Competencies are classified as the work habits, attitudes, personal characteristics, and behaviors that reflect how a person accomplishes the duties and responsibilities of his/her job.

  • Attention to Detail: Follows established guidelines and procedures to ensure accuracy; gets work right despite pressing deadlines; concentrates on routine work details and organizes and maintains a system of records; is alert and aware of surroundings and carefully monitors technical equipment or processes.
  • Commitment to Task: Demonstrates dependability and shows a sense of urgency about getting results; willing to commit the hours it takes to get the job completed; takes responsibility for actions and achieves results; overcomes obstacles.
  • Customer Focused: Commits to meeting the needs and expectations of the organization's internal and external customers; builds and maintains a customer base; delivers a high level of customer service; searches continually for ways to increase customer satisfaction (i.e., customer feedback).
  • Initiative: Takes action proactively; addresses issues or opportunities without supervision; focuses on desired results and accomplishments; demonstrates clear purpose, enthusiasm, and a "can-do" attitude.
  • Relationship Management: Initiates and develops relationships with others; demonstrates credibility; confronts conflict quickly and professionally; inspires confidence in others.
  • Teamwork: Works cooperatively with others to accomplish business goals and objectives; asks others for their ideas and opinions; supports team's decisions; contributes to the team's efforts.

Functional Skills

  • Cash management skills

Education and/or Experience

  • High School diploma or GED
  • Successful and stable employment history

Physical Demands. While performing the duties of this job, the team member is required to use hands repetitively, stand for prolonged periods, walk, grasp firmly/strongly and simply/lightly with hands, and use fine finger dexterity. The team member is frequently require to bend over, twist, reach above shoulder level, crouch or stoop, kneel, repetitively use feet, and use head and neck in a twisting or static motion and to look up and/or down, and lift and/or move up to 50 pounds. Occasionally, the team member is required to sit, climb, balance, push and/or pull, and lift and/or move over 51 pounds.

Work Environment. While performing the duties of this job, the team member is required to work outdoors in various temperatures, in a noisy environment, near moving mechanical parts, with dangerous equipment or sharp tools, and around fumes, odors, dust, or toxic chemicals.

Additional Information

  • Must be 18 years of age or older

  • Must be able to work long hours, scheduled or unscheduled, which will include nights, weekends, and as emergencies arise

  • Bilingual in certain markets
  • Work with phones, computers, and copiers
  • Non-exempt, hourly position

description:

This job provides direct and indirect care to patients during wellness visits, addressing psychosocial, physical, and preventive health needs. Communicates with patients, families, and the care team to coordinate services before the provider’s face-to-face visit. Follows regulatory guidelines and clinic policies under the supervision of a nurse practitioner or physician.

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Education

Work Experience

Required – 3 years of nursing experience

Preferred – Experience in home health or clinic setting

Certifications

Required – Current registered nurse (RN) license in state of practice.

Current Basic Life Support (BLS) certification from the American Heart Association.

Knowledge Skills and Abilities (KSAs)

  • Good organizational and time management skills and ability to be self-directed and demonstrate good judgement.
  • Good interpersonal skills.

Job Duties

  • Provides direct patient care, evaluates outcomes, assesses risk factors and patient needs, and consults with other health team members as required under the supervision of a NP and/or physician.

  • Ensures the provider has information documented for correct and complete billing of services rendered after face-to-face portion of the encounter. May also assist provider with procedures as needed, both technical and manual, under the supervision of a NP and/or physician.

The above statements describe the general nature and level of work only. They are not an exhaustive list of all required responsibilities, duties, and skills. Other duties may be added, or this description amended at any time.

Remains knowledgeable on current federal, state and local laws, accreditation standards or regulatory agency requirements that apply to the assigned area of responsibility and ensures compliance with all such laws, regulations and standards.

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Medium Work - Exerting 20 to 50 pounds of force occasionally, and/or 10 to 25 pounds of force frequently, and/or greater than negligible up to 10 pounds of force constantly to move objects. (Constantly: activity or condition exists 2/3 or more of the time) to move objects. Physical demand requirements are in excess of those for Sedentary Work. Even though the weight lifted may be only a negligible amount, a job should be rated Light Work: (1) when it requires walking or standing to a significant degree; or (2) when it requires sitting most of the time but entails pushing and/or pulling of arm or leg controls; and/or (3) when the job requires working at a production rate pace entailing the constant pushing and/or pulling of materials even though the weight of those materials is negligible. NOTE: The constant stress and strain of maintaining a production rate pace, especially in an industrial setting, can be and is physically demanding of a worker even though the amount of force exerted is negligible.

Duties performed routinely require exposure to blood, body fluid and tissue. The incumbent works in a patient care area; works in an area where patients enter; works directly with patients; and/or works with specimens that could contain communicable diseases. The incumbent has an occupational risk for exposure to all communicable diseases.

Because the incumbent works within a healthcare setting, there may be occupational risk for exposure to hazardous medications or hazardous waste within the environment through receipt, transport, storage, preparation, dispensing, administration, cleaning and/or disposal of contaminated waste.
